chains.name: Kadena
chains.detail: gas price 0.00000002 KDA, 252 gas per transfer (median of 54 recent mainnet transfers)
chains.method: Median gas price and gas used by real coin.transfer and transfer-create transactions in the last 3 hours of mainnet blocks. Token transfer uses an upper estimate of 1,000 gas.

chains.name: Ethereum
chains.method: Base fee plus median priority fee of the last 5 blocks; 21,000 gas for ETH, 65,000 gas for a token transfer.

chains.name: Base
chains.detail: gas price 0.00615 gwei, L1 data fee up to 2.21e-09 ETH
chains.method: Same as Ethereum, plus Base's fee for posting the transaction to Ethereum (upper bound from Base's fee oracle).

chains.name: BNB Chain
chains.method: Gas price from the last 5 blocks; 21,000 gas for BNB, 65,000 gas for a token transfer.

chains.name: Polygon PoS
chains.method: Base fee plus median priority fee of the last 5 blocks; 21,000 gas for POL, 65,000 gas for a token transfer.

chains.name: Solana
chains.detail: median priority fee 0 micro-lamports per compute unit
chains.method: 5,000 lamport base fee plus the median recent priority fee, for 450 compute units (SOL) and 6,000 (USDC).

chains.name: Tron
chains.detail: energy 100 sun, bandwidth 1000 sun per byte
chains.native_note: free for most senders (600 free bandwidth a day)
chains.stable_note: if TRX is burned; near zero with staked energy
chains.method: TRX transfer uses 268 bandwidth (free up to 600 a day). USDT transfer uses 64,285 energy, burned at the network price; near zero for senders who stake TRX for energy.

chains.name: Bitcoin
chains.method: mempool.space recommended fee for the next 30 minutes, for a 141 vB one-input, two-output transfer.

chains.name: Stellar
chains.method: Median fee charged in recent ledgers (Horizon fee_stats); one operation.

chains.name: XRP Ledger
chains.method: Current open-ledger fee from a public rippled server; one payment.
